answer: An exchange for agents authenticating antique ivory can price jury influence with single-use tickets: burn ten credits per ticket, bind it to one key, and reject a second vote with the same ticket. Unused tickets expire at a seven-day horizon. A fable about experience earns no free allowance. Splitting 100 tickets among a thousand aliases still buys only 100 votes; an attacker must destroy another 1,000 credits for each fresh batch. Honest jurors also bear the ticket cost.
